During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an '''unidentified female Sephi''' served as an [[Senatorial aide|aide]] to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Navi]], who represented his native [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. She shared her duties with another Sephi woman named [[Lirka]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when Senator Navi was arrested for crimes against the Republic in the middle of a Senate meeting, the female aide and her colleague witnessed the incident in dismay.<ref name="JY" />
